summary: Your own item types, and changes to the game's items. A registered type is a miscellaneous item that borrows an existing item's look, gets a stable GUID from its id, and works with all inventory, stash and ground item calls. Overrides change a game item's weight, price, stats and the most units a player can hold, for all players. The server's item-config.json in the resources folder sets the same at startup: { "<item GUID or name>": { "weight": kg, "price": price, "max": units, <stat>: value } }. The event playerCustomItemUse fires when a usable type is used.

info.summary: What kind of item a class is. It has `category`, as from Inventory.classes, such as meleeWeapon, missileWeapon, armor or food. A weapon also has `weaponClass` from the game's table: dagger, sword, sabre, axe, longsword, mace, flail, halberd, shield, shieldBroken, huntingSword, torch, bow, crossbowLight, crossbowMedium, crossbowHeavy or rifle, otherwise null. It also has the attack modifiers `attackModSlash`, `attackModStab` and `attackModSmash`, otherwise 0. Use the modifiers to find out what a weapon can do, since the game's tables class a broken axe as a mace, with no slash. Null for an unknown class. A registered type is a misc item with no weapon class.

params.item: The item class, by GUID or name in the game's item table.

info.returns: { id, name, category, weaponClass, attackModSlash, attackModStab, attackModSmash } | null
info.exampleLua:
-- Only a blade cuts the rope.
local tool = kcds.players.Items.info("axeBattle01")
local cuts = tool ~= nil and tool.attackModSlash > 0

model.summary: The mesh an item class has on the ground: its own model from the game's item tables, or for clothing and armour, the drop model. It is a path under objects/, or '' if the tables give none, as with DLC badges that only pin to a cap. Most of them, all .cgf files, are props too, so Prop.spawn can show an item alone, held still with physics 'none'. Throws a TypeError for an unknown class.

params.item: The item class, by GUID or name in the game's item table.

model.exampleLua:
-- A sword on its own, hanging still in the air.
local model = kcds.players.Items.model("longSwordDuel")
if model:endsWith(".cgf") then
  local spot = kcds.math.Vector3.new(1650, 2151, 37)
  kcds.world.Prop.spawn(model, spot, nil, nil, "none")
end

register.summary: Creates a custom item type and returns its GUID. Registering it identically again returns the same GUID. The limit is 4096 types.

params.id: Your id for it: letters, digits and :_-., up to 128 bytes.
params.definition: `name`, required, up to 256 bytes; `description`; `visual`, the miscellaneous item, crafting material or document it looks like; `model`, optional, a mesh of the prop catalogue as Prop.spawn takes it (such as 'manmade/common_furniture/bucket/bucket_a_a'), which it then lies on the ground as, shows in shops and Items.model returns, where a mesh the catalogue lacks throws a TypeError; `weight` in kg; `price`, a whole number of money units; `stackable`, default true; `usable` and `useLabel`, default 'Use', which offer a use action on the inventory screen; `icon`, an image your resource ships to clients.

register.exampleLua:
local Items, Inventory = kcds.players.Items, kcds.players.Inventory

local sealedLetter = Items.register("myres:sealed_letter", { name = "Sealed letter", description = "A letter with the seal of the burgrave.", visual = "crime_letterOfRecognition", weight = 0.1, usable = true, useLabel = "Break the seal" })
Inventory.add(player, { item = sealedLetter, amount = 1 })

kcds.core.Events.on("playerCustomItemUse", function(reader, row, revision)
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(reader, "The seal breaks.")
end)

override.summary: Changes a game item for all players and returns its effective values.

params.item: The item, by name or GUID.
params.fields: `weight`, `price`, `max` (units a player can hold), and stats for its category, such as armour defence, weapon attack or food health. Fields left out keep the game's value.

override.returns: { id, name, weight, price, max, stats, overridden }

clearOverride.summary: Restores an item's game values, and returns whether it had an override.

effective.summary: An item's values on this server, or null for an unknown item.

params.item: The item, by name or GUID.

effective.returns: { id, name, weight, price, max, stats, overridden } | null
effective.exampleLua:
local apple = kcds.players.Items.effective("apple")
print(tostring(apple.name) .. ": " .. tostring(apple.weight) .. " kg, " .. tostring(apple.price))

overrides.summary: The effective values of all overridden items.
overrides.exampleLua:
for _, item in ipairs(kcds.players.Items.overrides()) do
  print(item.name, item.price)
end

equippedWeightPercent.summary: The percentage of what players wear that counts toward their load, under the server's rule. 100 by default.

setEquippedWeightPercent.summary: Sets the percentage of what players wear that counts toward their load. Player.setEquippedWeightPercent overrides it for one player.
